name: Semantika
description:
Semantika tracks how your brand shows up inside AI answers, not just in search results.

Connect it and Claude can pull your visibility data directly: which prompts mention you, which mention your competitors, how often, in what tone, and which sources the engines cite when they answer.

What you get through this connector:
- Visibility and share of voice per prompt, per engine, per brand
- Competitor mentions side by side with yours
- Sentiment and framing of each mention
- The sources cited in AI answers, so you know which pages actually feed the models
- A prioritised queue of recommended actions, ranked by impact and effort
- Historical data, so you can see what moved after you shipped a change

Engines covered: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Bing Copilot, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode.

Built for marketing teams, SEO teams and agencies who need numbers instead of opening five chatbots every Monday. Agency accounts can pull data for multiple client brands through the same connection.

Authentication uses an access token from your Semantika account. Plans start at 49€/month, with a free trial.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Semantika to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Semantika to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://beta.semantika.pt/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Semantika MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Semantika provides these MCP tools: get_action, get_report, get_visibility, list_actions, list_brands, and list_prompts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Semantika?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Semantika in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Semantika requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Semantika is developed by Semantika. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
